positioning.unit_of_planning: the decision to pursue a goal at all
positioning.scope: assessment, prioritisation, risk and review cadence
positioning.one_line: Starts before the goal: score twelve life areas, cut nine candidates down to three on impact against effort, assess the risk to each while you still have options, then review weekly and monthly on a fixed cadence.

primary: People who set goals every January and abandon them by March
Anyone running more goals than evenings

differentiators: Life Areas Assessment — twelve areas scored one to ten before any goal is written
Gap Analysis — the lowest scores, and what would actually move them
Priority Matrix on impact against effort, ending in three survivors
Risk Assessment scored for likelihood and impact, with a mitigation threshold
Habit Alignment — every habit answers to a goal or is not counted as progress
Weekly Review and Monthly Review as separate fixed-cadence pages
Thirteen-week Progress Dashboard across three goals plus habits
Four sizes, verified page and link parity

differs_from.005-goal-planner: SEVERE OVERLAP — SAME CATEGORY. 06 is horizon-based: vision, annual, SMART, OKR, quarter, twelve month calendars, five weeks, seven hour-gridded days, plus habits, obstacles, lessons and celebration. This product is selection-based: assess, prioritise, risk, align, review. 06 answers how to plan a goal you have chosen; this answers which goal to choose and whether it survives contact with your life. Both must not be listed with similar titles or first lines.

catalogue_warning: Third shadow product built after an overlap was flagged (see also 10-meeting-planner-pro). The shop now holds three pairs competing in the same categories. Recommend resolving all three together rather than one at a time: decide for each pair whether to retitle, delist the original, or merge.

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
